text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having narrowly missed victory, Mejiro 
Ramonu was disheartened, wondering if the 
race had spurned her. Her Trainer 
encouraged her, telling her to show her 
love next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd, too, held high hopes. They 
believed her powerful running would secure 
the remaining two crowns. The other 
runners continued to gaze upon her with 
unceasing envy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the second race of the Tiara 
route: the Yushun Himba (Oaks). Mejiro 
Ramonu seeks a race that will stir her 
love even more deeply.
